name: AABB Voxel Intersection
definition: Checks if two voxel sprites intersect by computing the axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) overlap and iterating through all voxel coordinates within that overlap.
summary: AABB Voxel Intersection is a brute-force method that checks every integer coordinate within a bounding box to detect collisions, differing from hierarchical approaches by iterating all voxels directly.
